intro: Blue Archive Heardle is a free fan game, made and run by one person, ShinRunner1st. You can play every game without an account. Signing in is optional: it keeps your progress and profile across devices, opens every mission and reward, and keeps a verified record of your dailies and room games.

sections.title: Playing without an account
paragraphs: Your scores, streaks, missions, profile and settings are saved only in this browser. Nothing about them is sent anywhere. There's no save file to move them: clearing this browser's data, or playing on another device, starts again.
As a guest you can clear a few starter missions, and wear what they unlock; every other mission and reward, and verified results, need an account.

In Multiplayer, a room gets the name and picture from your profile (or the student you pick for it), the title, banner, frame, background and name effect you picked, and your answers, and shows them to the other players in it. When the room closes, everything about it is deleted. Your browser keeps a random key for each room you were in, for a few hours, so a tab closed by mistake can go back in as you.

sections.title: If you sign in
paragraphs: You sign in with Google or Discord, and can link both to one account. For it, we keep:

An account starts fresh. When you sign in, this browser's progress as a guest is deleted, not brought into the account, and the account's progress takes its place. When you sign out, the account's progress is cleared from this browser, which goes back to being a new guest. Your progress stays in your account.
list: your Google or Discord account's id: a number that tells us it's you, not your email, name or picture there;
the name and favourite student you set in your profile, and the title, banner, frame, background, name effect and Sensei card colours you picked;

your progress: your rounds in every game and mode, your multiplayer games and the missions you've cleared, as a copy of your save, and the copy from before the last time two of your devices' progress was joined;
a summary of your record (rounds played, wins, best streaks and the like), worked out from your progress;
your verified results, and your daily time zone: see Verified results below;
whether players in a room with you can see your profile from your card: on, unless you turn it off (see Who sees what);
when the account was made and last used, and for each device you're signed in on, a scrambled form of its sign-in key and when it runs out.

sections.title: Verified results
paragraphs: Signed in, each daily you play is also kept as a verified result, apart from your progress. As the daily starts (its first clip, line or picture, or your first guess), our server notes which daily, which day and when. When it ends, your browser sends your guesses in order (with your skips, and whether you gave up); the server judges them itself with the game's own rules and keeps the result (won, lost, or not finished in time), the tries, the guesses, when it finished, and whether its time counted. The time is the server's own clock, from start to finish.

From a multiplayer game played to its end while signed in, the room signs a short receipt of your result: the game, typed or 4-Choice, the rounds, how many played, your place and score, and when it ended. Your browser brings it to your account, which counts each game once.

To know which day's puzzle is yours, your account keeps your daily time zone: its name, such as Asia/Bangkok, as your device sets it, the first time you play a verified daily (and again if you change it). It says roughly where you are; it's never looked up from your address, and it's used for nothing else.

Why: so your account has a record the server saw and judged itself, apart from your own browser's record, which can be changed, and verified streaks that can't be made up or replayed. You see it on your profile's Verified tab, and players in a room with you can see its totals from your card, unless you hide your profile (see Who sees what). There are no leaderboards, and no list or search of players.

What it doesn't promise: verified means our server started, judged and timed it. It doesn't mean nobody cheated. The answers are in the game's own files, so they can be looked up, a changed page can play differently, and anyone can make more than one account. Verified results stop made-up and replayed results; they aren't cheat-proof.

Dailies played offline stay in your progress, and are never made verified later, and those played as a guest go with the rest of a guest's progress when you sign in; nothing from your saves is ever counted as verified. Your browser keeps a note of verified dailies under way and receipts not yet taken, until your account has them, and clears it when you sign out.
Your verified results and daily time zone are kept as long as your account. They're in Download my data, and Delete account removes them with everything else.

sections.title: What we never keep
list: your email address, or your name, picture or friends on Google or Discord;
your IP address, in our database, our logs (they're off) or the rooms;
cookies, ads, analytics or tracking of any kind, signed in or not. The site loads no one else's scripts.

sections.title: Your IP address
paragraphs: Cloudflare, which runs the site, sees your IP address to send you its pages, as for any website.

To stop anyone making rooms or signing in by the hundred, the site counts requests from each address in one-minute windows, with Cloudflare's rate limiter. It hands the limiter a hashed form of your address (scrambled one way, not the address itself) and stores neither anywhere of its own. Cloudflare keeps that count for its limiter, under Cloudflare's own privacy policy; it doesn't publish how long.

sections.title: Who sees what
paragraphs: Other players in a room see your name, picture, title, banner, frame, background and name effect while you're in it.

Signed in, players in a room with you, guests too, can also tap your card to see your profile: the totals of your verified results (for each daily played, how many and how many won, your best streak and fastest verified find; your room games and places; since when) and the summary of your own saves (rounds and days played, dailies won, best streaks, songs guessed, students found, missions, OST badges, room games), shown as from your own saves, not verified. Only while they're in the same room as you: the room hands their page a ticket for your profile that works for a few minutes, and never your account's id.

They never see your Google or Discord account, your time zone, your dailies one by one or your guesses, and nobody can look you up outside a room. To hide your profile: ☰ Profile, Account, Your profile in rooms; it takes effect at once.
Nobody else sees your progress. If others can ever see more, this page will say so first.

sections.title: Where it's kept
paragraphs: On Cloudflare, which runs the site: its Workers answer the requests and its D1 database keeps accounts. Google and Discord are only asked who you are when you sign in, and are told nothing about how you play.

sections.title: How long
paragraphs: An account, and everything kept for it (your verified results and daily time zone too), is kept until you delete it, or until it's gone unused for two years (no sign-in and no sync from any device), when it's deleted the same way. A device's sign-in ends after 90 days without use.

After an account is deleted, the database's recovery history (Cloudflare D1's Time Travel, which is always on and can put the whole database back as it was at an earlier moment) can still bring it back for up to 7 days, on the free plan the site uses; Cloudflare's paid plan keeps 30 days, and this page will change first if the site ever moves to it. After that, it can't be brought back that way. A room's data lasts only while the room is open.

sections.title: Your choices
list: Download everything kept for your account, at any time, your verified results and daily time zone included: ☰ Profile, Account, Download my data.

Delete your account and everything kept for it, at any time, your verified results and daily time zone included: ☰ Profile, Account, Delete account. This browser is cleared too, and goes back to being a new guest.
Hide your profile from players in rooms, or show it again: ☰ Profile, Account, Your profile in rooms. Your card in a room still shows your name, picture and cosmetics.
Sign out: the account's progress is cleared from this browser, and stays in your account.

Remove the site from your Google account under Security, Your connections to third-party apps and services, or from Discord under User Settings, Authorized Apps. Neither gave us anything to take back, so this only tidies their list.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Google and Discord accounts are for people 13 and over (older in some countries), and so is signing in here. The site isn't aimed at younger children.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If what the site keeps changes, this page changes first, with its date, and What's new says so.

sections.title: Questions
paragraphs: Write to {contact} about your privacy, your data or deleting it.
